name: AI Feynman Symbolic Regression Benchmark
description: AI Feynman is a symbolic regression benchmark derived from equations in the Feynman Lectures on Physics. It evaluates whether an algorithm can recover compact symbolic expressions from numeric input-output data, emphasizing discovery of interpretable physical laws.
evaluation_method: exact equation recovery or near-exact symbolic match, often reported as the fraction of equations correctly discovered
notes: The original benchmark includes 100 equations and reports that the proposed method discovered all of them. Actual evaluation may consider exact symbolic equivalence and simplification.
